description: Lists the trade secret register entries the user can open in the connected Lightbringer organisation, as index rows: reference, title, status and dates. Entry content is not included. Which entries appear follows the user’s register access in Lightbringer, and an empty list means the user can open none. Returns up to 25 entries per page with a cursor for the next page.

limit.description: How many register entries to return

name: list_trade_secrets

markedAt.description: When the entry was marked as a trade secret (ISO 8601, UTC)

status.description: Assessed status; null means not assessed, not that the entry is secret

title.description: Non-revealing title, or null when none has been set

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

title: List trade secret register
